cfg.kineticdummy.dummy.apply_notice: Most server settings apply immediately. Extra Curios slots affect newly initialized dummies; sync interval changes apply immediately and pending damage updates coalesce between sends.
cfg.kineticdummy.dummy.blacklist.tooltip: Set equipment that the dummy is not allowed to wear. Supports Item IDs, @ModID, and #TagID.
cfg.kineticdummy.dummy.broadcastRange.to: §bSet the broadcast distance for dummy combat data, only players within range will receive it
cfg.kineticdummy.dummy.client.descriptio: Local display preferences. These settings remain editable while connected to a remote server.
cfg.kineticdummy.dummy.colorCrit.tooltip: Color used for critical or high-damage numbers.
cfg.kineticdummy.dummy.colorMinion.toolt: Color used for damage caused by your minions.
cfg.kineticdummy.dummy.colorNormal.toolt: Color used for ordinary damage numbers.
cfg.kineticdummy.dummy.colorOverDps.tool: Color of the overhead DPS line.
cfg.kineticdummy.dummy.colorOverSource.t: Color of the overhead damage-source line.
cfg.kineticdummy.dummy.colorOverStats.to: Color of overhead total-damage and hit-count values.
cfg.kineticdummy.dummy.colorOverType.too: Color of the overhead damage-type line.
cfg.kineticdummy.dummy.colorSumTime.tool: Color of the combat duration and DPS line.
cfg.kineticdummy.dummy.curioExtraSlots.t: Extra Curios slots available to a dummy. Lower values reduce tick cost.
cfg.kineticdummy.dummy.standbyCheckInter: How often nearby players are checked, with a minimum of 0.05 seconds.
cfg.kineticdummy.dummy.standbyRange.tool: Range to check for player presence. If no players are nearby, the dummy enters standby mode: it will be ignored by all mobs and become invincible to non-player damage. Player attacks always remain effective regardless of distance.
cfg.kineticdummy.dummy.summaryDuration.t: How many seconds the combat summary remains visible.
cfg.kineticdummy.dummy.syncInterval.tool: Actual server-side interval between realtime damage sends; hits are coalesced while waiting. Minimum: 0.05 seconds.
cfg.kineticdummy.dummy.server.descriptio: Server-owned dummy rules. This page is disabled while connected to a remote server because no authenticated synchronization protocol exists.
cmd.kineticdummy.dummy.clear.desc: §6Clear all test dummies in the world
gui.kineticdummy.dummy.curios_ext.no_slo: No Curio slots available. Please check JSON config.
gui.kineticdummy.dummy.curios_ext.title: Dummy Curios Config
jade.kineticdummy.dummy.edit_hint: §6[Hint] §aEmpty hand + Sneak + Right to edit dummy
msg.kineticdummy.dummy.blacklisted: §cThis item is blacklisted and cannot be equipped!
msg.kineticdummy.dummy.not_a_curio: §cThe item in hand is not a valid Curio. Please check the dummy's Curios config and ensure you have the correct item.
tip.kineticdummy.dummy.environment_damag: Whether the dummy checks block/environment damage. Disabled by default to reduce checks while standing in fire, cactus, sweet berry bushes, etc. Enable it with i-frames off for high-frequency environment damage testing.
cfg.kineticdummy.dummy.showParticles.too: Whether to show floating damage numbers when mobs take damage.
Whether to accumulate damage dealt to the same mob during continuous attacks. The value clears after 3 seconds without damage.
cfg.kineticdummy.dummy.particleScale.too: Overall scale multiplier for damage number particles.
cfg.kineticdummy.dummy.particleSpread.to: Random spread range for damage particles to prevent overlap.
Whether to show damage numbers dealt by minions, visible only to their owner.
cfg.kineticdummy.dummy.showOverSource.to: Whether to display the damage source above the entity.
cfg.kineticdummy.dummy.showOverType.tool: Whether to display the damage type above the entity.
cfg.kineticdummy.dummy.showOverAvgDps.to: Whether to display average DPS above the entity.
cfg.kineticdummy.dummy.overScale.tooltip: Overall scale multiplier for the overhead text information.
cfg.kineticdummy.dummy.overOffset.toolti: Vertical height offset for the overhead text relative to the entity.
cfg.kineticdummy.dummy.showSummary.toolt: Whether to enable the combat summary HUD after an entity dies.
cfg.kineticdummy.dummy.showSummaryKill.t: Whether to display the killed target's name in the summary.
Whether to display detailed damage statistics such as total damage and hit count.
cfg.kineticdummy.dummy.showSummaryTime.t: Whether to display combat duration in the summary.
cfg.kineticdummy.dummy.sumScale.tooltip: Overall scale multiplier for the summary HUD.
gui.kineticdummy.module.name: KineticDummy
gui.kineticdummy.module.tooltip: Provides damage-testing dummies and manages damage statistics, display, and dummy behavior.
